# Tinct

Tinct is a deep-reading platform for public-domain classics. It offers free online reading, original texts, modern English and modern Danish editions, context-aware AI help, synced audio, notes, highlights, and spoiler-aware character guides.

## Main Pages

- Home: https://tinct.app/
- Library: https://tinct.app/read
- About: https://tinct.app/about.html
- Sitemap: https://tinct.app/sitemap.xml

- The Odyssey: https://tinct.app/read/odyssey/summary
- War and Peace: https://tinct.app/read/war-and-peace/summary
- Crime and Punishment: https://tinct.app/read/crime-and-punishment/summary
- Pride and Prejudice: https://tinct.app/read/pride-and-prejudice/summary
- Hamlet: https://tinct.app/read/hamlet/summary
- The Republic: https://tinct.app/read/the-republic/summary
- Meditations: https://tinct.app/read/meditations/summary
- Jane Eyre: https://tinct.app/read/jane-eyre/summary
- Frankenstein: https://tinct.app/read/frankenstein/summary
- The Divine Comedy: https://tinct.app/read/divine-comedy/summary

## Crawling Guidance

Use the public HTML pages for citations and summaries. Do not crawl `/data/`, `/api/`, `/audio/`, or app-internal assets for bulk extraction. The edition texts are public-domain-derived, but the product experience, alignment, metadata, and reading tools are the canonical Tinct surface.
